notes: Modified cash basis city (business-type activities on accrual basis). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis, Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Intergovernmental 301,206 split by the printed Street Fund budget lines (p15) and General Fund State assistance (p20); Grants and contributions 22,841 split into CDBG Grant income 22,059 (p18) and Library 782 (p21). Total column prints net Transfers in (out) (183,800); gross transfers in 252,500 / out 436,300 taken from the fund columns. Beginning cash not printed; ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash lines (p4); fund balances 3,395,476 -> 3,175,132. Internal service fund (governmental activities) excluded from governmental lines. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total enterprise column (pp8-9), measure net position; proprietary cash flows Total column pp10-13. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) by Governmental / Business-type column, since it carries capital assets and debt; component unit excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departments combining statement (pp20-21; the General Fund budget schedule p14 is not recorded to avoid double counting); Street, Sales Tax, LB840 and CDBG budget schedules (pp15-18, zero-actual lines omitted); nonmajor Keno, Nolde Trust and Cemetery Perpetual Care funds from the combining statement (p19); utility funds (Light, Water, Sewer, Trash) from the proprietary statement fund columns (pp8-9) since no utility schedules are printed. The Debt Service Fund budget schedule (report p64) is not in the trim, so the Debt Service Fund has no detail lines. Read pages 1-21 of 21
